intent: Add a fail-fast worker-side consistency check for typed R/J/O requests that require canonical Reality from an explicitly dimension-incomplete CAP-0003 projection, while preserving existing epistemic semantics.
rationale_summary: No capability is missing. CAP-0003 already owns Fact dimension completeness and canonical reconciliation; CAP-0007 already owns fail-closed trajectory execution; CAP-0009 owns durable fresh-agent continuity; CAP-0010 owns workstream routing. The observed Shipping failure was a request/projection consistency defect that should be detected before integration runtime, not a reason to fork or weaken any semantic owner.
